theme_settings.rationale: Matches Islamic corporate professional environment. Light warm gray background (#F8FAFC) creates a clean, trust-inspiring canvas, ensuring high readability for dense contract data.

headings.rationale: Authoritative yet approachable sans-serif. Avoids generic Inter. Adds professional character.
headings.styles: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), font-bold for primary KPIs, font-semibold for standard headers.

body.rationale: Highly legible, modern geometric sans that pairs perfectly with Manrope, popular in Indonesian tech ecosystems.

anti_patterns: No generic Inter or Roboto for headings.
No centered layouts for dense data.
Do not use text sizes larger than text-4xl for dashboards; keep it compact.

primary.name: Deep Teal
primary.usage: Brand identity, top navbar, primary action buttons, active states, breadcrumbs.

accent.name: Warm Gold
accent.usage: Highlighted badges, notification indicators, secondary prominent buttons.

visual_enhancers.borders: Soft borders (border-slate-200) on all surface elements (cards, panels) to create crisp definition without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm or custom shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]) for cards. Avoid heavy or muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Rounded gradient card headers with dark backgrounds (e.g., bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 to-slate-800) selectively used for hero/highlight cards as requested.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating action buttons or sticky headers if they overlap content. Otherwise, rely on solid Crisp White surfaces to prevent visual refraction of data.

component_guidelines.navbar: Top navigation bar styled with Deep Teal. Contains a clean logo 'BSI Maslahat | CRS', user avatar, and quick search. Must remain fixed at the top (sticky top-0 z-50).
component_guidelines.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar navigation. Active states must use BSI Maslahat Deep Teal (#008A85) background or prominent text/icon color with a left border indicator.
component_guidelines.kpi_cards: Bento-style grid. Features a left-border accent (border-l-4) using status colors. Use dark rounded gradient headers for primary context if needed.
component_guidelines.data_table: Contract data grid with F-pattern scanning. Left-align columns. Include search + filters (Institution Type, Owning BU). Use pill-shaped status badges.
component_guidelines.modals_side_panels: Contract detail side-panel (Sheet component) or modal for metadata grid, version history, and audit trail timeline. Must use crisp 1px borders and solid white background.
component_guidelines.forms: Drafting & submission form using standard Shadcn form components but styled organically. Includes a 'smart-info' button triggering a Legal Guidelines matrix modal, and a drag-and-drop file upload zone (dashed border-slate-300, hover:border-teal-500).
component_guidelines.floating_action_buttons: Pill-shaped floating buttons in the bottom right: 'LAPORKAN SEKARANG' (Report Now - Red/Rose pill) and 'Tanya aku!' (AI helper - Teal pill). Must use shadow-lg and hover:-translate-y-1 transition.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to let data breathe.
grids_layouts.grid_strategy: High Density Grid for dashboards. Dashboard KPI cards use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment prioritized. Forms and tables strictly left-aligned.

motion_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly define hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-teal-800 for primary buttons). Cards should have a slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow enhancement on hover.
motion_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions: 'transition-colors duration-200' or 'transition-transform duration-200'. NO 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over Teal or Gold backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio (use white text on Teal, dark gray/black on Gold).
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default). For specific brand elements, match standard corporate weights (stroke-width 1.5).

instructions_to_main_agent: Start by establishing the Layout shell: Top Navbar (sticky, Teal background) and Collapsible Sidebar.
Implement the Dashboard view with 4 KPI cards (Total Active, Pending Verification, Expiring Soon, Expired) using the High Density Grid pattern.
Build the Contract Data Table with filtering dropdowns and status badges. Integrate a 'View Details' action opening a Sheet/Side-panel.
Create the Contract Details side-panel featuring a metadata grid and an audit trail timeline.
Implement the Drafting & Submission form with a drag-and-drop zone and 'smart-info' modal.
Add the Floating Action Buttons ('LAPORKAN SEKARANG', 'Tanya aku!') fixed to the bottom right.
Ensure all components are strictly written in .js (JavaScript React) and not TypeScript.
Utilize Shadcn UI components heavily but customize them to match the BSI Maslahat brand colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics: no uniform styling or generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
NEVER use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭) for icons; stick to lucide-react.
Ensure all hover, focus, and active states are clearly defined.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Use pill-shaped or sharp buttons rather than generic rounded defaults.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and forms.
